title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Tea Party on 1969-12-30
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture of a long, jam‑heavy night with standout Dark Star, New Speedway Boogie and an inspired Alligator → Eleven transition.
ai_review.review: The recording is a decent‑quality soundboard source that sounds a little rough in places and has a few bad cuts, but it remains listenable. Musically the show shines – long winding jams dominate the second half, with Dark Star, New Speedway Boogie, Black Peter and an unexpected Alligator → Eleven sequence earning high praise from fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong positive comments about the performance (standout jams, song transitions) combined with generally good but not perfect recording quality yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall solid soundboard capture; some reviewers note rough EQ and occasional bad cuts/dropouts, but the mix remains clear enough to enjoy the jams.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A long, jam‑laden second half with fluid transitions (e.g., Alligator into Eleven) that builds momentum; first set solid but less highlighted.
